title: Enhanced dye removal and supercapacitor performance of polyethyleneimine-impregnated activated carbon derived from local eucalyptus biochar
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00421C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bordin Weerasuk, Threeraphat Chutimasakul, Nicha Prigyai, Tanagorn Sangtawesin
This study evaluated the effectiveness of low-cost eucalyptus biochar (EUBC) as a precursor for activated carbon (EUAC), for methyl orange (MO) removal and supercapacitor applications.
